GTFS INPUTS
===========

Purpose and placement
---------------------
These static GTFS ZIP archives supply transit schedules to r5py. The current
routing scripts expect the required archives directly in:

    <repository-root>/

Keep the filenames below unchanged unless the routing configuration is updated.
GTFS publishers update their feeds regularly; official links generally provide
the newest feed, not the exact historical version used in this analysis. The
dates and SHA-256 checksums below identify the archived project copies.

Official publisher pages
------------------------
MTA developer resources (subway, NYC buses, and LIRR):
https://www.mta.info/developers

Nassau Inter-County Express (NICE) GTFS page:
https://www.nicebus.com/Passenger-Information/App-showcase

Suffolk County Transit GTFS page:
https://suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Economic-Development-and-Planning/Transportation/General-Transit-Feed-Specification-Details

Reproduction notes
------------------
1. Download the required feeds from the official publisher pages.
2. Rename them to the expected filenames above and place them at the repository
   root, or update the routing scripts' FILES configuration to their locations.
3. For exact historical replication, use archived files matching the checksums.
   If those exact files are deposited on Zenodo, OSF, or another permanent
   archive, add the permanent record URL to this manifest.

These potentially large, frequently changing ZIP archives are intentionally
excluded from Git.
